text: [image: Ballots go in the mail across Washington today. Vote the whole ballot, top to bottom, and return it early – by mail with no stamp needed, or at any drop box. Then check in with two people you know and make sure they do the same. Not registered yet? You can still register online or by mail through October 26, or in person through Election Day, November 3. [image: Spokane Public Radio asked me what I would do first. Two things. Bring costs down by restoring a predictable trade regime: reset tariffs to where they were in January 2025 and fully restore USMCA, so businesses and families can plan again. End the war with Iran. It is expensive, and we are all seeing it at the gas pump. Whether we go to war is Congress's decision, and five times Michael Baumgartner voted not to even have that discussion. Listen to the full interview: https://www.spokanepublicradio.org/regional-news/2026-10-01/congressional-candidate-carmela-conroy-talks-affordability-ai-iran-war]
